verdict.rationale: Google Voice is a business telephony service, so webhooks for call and message events are a fair axis, but the pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The closest items are BigQuery reporting and a Reports API endpoint that lists activities. Both are pull-based analytics, adjacent to the story rather than event webhooks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, call and message events arrive as webhooks I can wire into my own systems
